events.title: MAFIA HOTEL Demo Is Live!
events.summary: The MAFIA HOTEL demo is now available on Steam!No key is required—download the demo, invite your friends, and start playing. The demo includes the complete gameplay experience currently available.Please remember that MAFIA HOTEL requires at least four players to start a match.This is still an early build, so you may encounter bugs. events.title: The Mafia Hotel Demo Arrives Next Week!
events.summary: Hello everyone!We’re excited to announce that the first public demo for Mafia Hotel will be available next week!Mafia Hotel is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. During the day, players talk, lie, accuse, and vote. At night, everyone returns to their hotel rooms—but the Mafia may come knocking.The game is still in early development, so the demo will not represent the final experience.
